question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated authority, reinforced through military purges and party control since the 2022 congress, underpins the near-certain trader consensus that he will remain CCP general secretary through 2026. As of mid-2026, Xi continues directing policy on the 15th Five-Year Plan, energy security, and diplomatic engagement, including planned summits, with no public signs of resignation, health impediments, or elite challenges that could trigger removal. The 21st Party Congress in 2027 is widely viewed as the next inflection point for a likely fourth term rather than succession. While political outcomes remain subject to unforeseen events such as acute health developments or internal shifts, current institutional dominance and absence of viable alternatives sustain the implied 95.5% probability against an earlier exit.
